column2:
Dear [Root.GetFirstName],

I would like to invite you to a small gathering of friends, to dine and drink and forget the world outside for a little while. The cellars are full, the cooks are eager and the musicians have been warned. Do set aside a few days, in case we get truly into the spirit of things.

Yours,
[FromFrom.GetTitledName]

Dear [Root.GetFirstName],

The new brew is ready, and it would be a grudge against the brewmaster to drink it alone. Come to my hall and help us find the bottom of the barrels. Bring your appetite and your oldest songs, and leave your sorrows at the gate. Few will be left standing by the end, and fewer will remember it.

Yours, by the beard of my fathers,
[FromFrom.GetTitledName]

Dearest [Root.GetFirstName],

Life is so very short, and so very dull. Come to me and let us make it neither. There will be wine from the vineyards of Bretonnia and fruit from beyond the Great Ocean, perfumes and music, and certain other delights I shall not put in writing. Come as you are, and leave as someone else.

Yours in every sense,
[FromFrom.GetTitledName]
Of course I will come!
Unfortunately, I can't.
[FromFrom.GetHerHis] open decadence is shameful, and I will tell [FromFrom.GetHerHim] so!

Dear [GetFromReverseRelation],

Of course I will come and feast with you. I will bring my best appetite for revelry!

Yours,
[From.GetTitledName]
This should be fun!

Dear [GetFromReverseRelation],

Unfortunately I cannot join you for merrymaking at this time. Thank you for your kind invitation.

Until next time,
[From.GetTitledName]
Ah, [From.GetSheHe] doesn't know what [From.GetSheHe]'s missing.

Dear [GetFromReverseRelation],

It saddens me that you have become such a decadent wretch. Surely [From.Religion.GetRandomEvilGodName] laughs at your excesses, but I, for one, will have no part in them. Wine is the first step on the road the Lord of Pleasure walks.

In hope of your redemption,
[From.GetTitledName]
What??
At least [From.Religion.GetRandomEvilGodName] has a sense of humour.
Unfortunate circumstances have forced me to cancel the feast I had planned.

Dear [GetFromReverseRelation],

Unfortunate circumstances force me to cancel the feast we had planned. We will make up for it when times are happier.

Until then,
[From.GetTitledName]
No one accepted my invitation. One person makes no feast, so it will have to wait for another day.
People are so boring!

My guests have arrived for the private feast I have arranged. The tables groan under roast boar and Reikland sausage, Tilean wine flows from the casks, and the minstrels are already drunk. Let the carousing begin!

My guests have arrived for the feast. The tables groan under roast goat and mushroom pies, the barrels of the new brew are tapped, and a cask of genuine Bugman's has been brought up from the deepest cellar for the occasion. Let the drinking begin!
Let's get it started!
I have arrived at the private rooms of [From.GetTitledFirstName]. There is food and drink in plenty, and the mood is decidedly merry. I am looking forward to this!
Let's get... it started!

Late on the third night of feasting I sit awake, alone, among the ruins of the revel. On a couch beside me sprawls one of my companions, in a deep and drunken sleep, defenceless and beautiful, skin glowing in the candlelight. The carving knife is still on the table.
How peaceful this is.
I think I will try some...
After several days of feasting together the attraction keeps growing, and I know we are both thinking of the same thing...
Let's do it!
No, we'd better not.

After several days of feasting together, I have often caught [From.GetFirstName] looking at me in that 'special' way. At last, after a late cup of wine, [From.GetSheHe] puts [From.GetHerHis] arms around me and whispers a delicious proposal in my ear...
Yes!
No!
[From.GetFirstName] welcomed my advances, and we spent the rest of the night together, enjoying each other...
I hope I'm not too drunk to remember this later!
[From.GetFirstName] declined my amorous advances. I excuse myself and return to the pleasures of the table. Soon the embarrassing moment is forgotten... almost.
Cheers!
These days of revelry are a fine escape. So many laughs and so many heartfelt conversations in so short a time... It brings me closer to my companions, and I feel we are good friends already.
You're my... best friend!
Is it the drink? Is it something someone said? I don't remember, honestly, but someone has to pay! Fight!
Put 'em up!

Good drink and food and merry company, and everything is fine. Or was, until [From.GetTitledFirstName] suddenly flew into a rage. I am not sure why, but [From.GetSheHe] is coming at me right now with [From.GetHerHis] fists up.
Well, if that's what you want!
Listen to me and calm down...
I must run and hide!
[From.GetTitledFirstName] put up a good fight, in spite of being just as drunk as I. After a while we were both exhausted and had to call it a draw.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] spoke to me calmly, explaining that there was no need to be upset. I thought about it for a moment and realised [From.GetSheHe] was right. We ended up sitting down to eat and drink together again.
At the last moment [From.GetSheHe] ran, after throwing a chair at my legs. I searched everywhere but could not find [From.GetHerHim].
Ooh, that hurts!
I honestly don't remember what I was so angry about.
Maybe it's just as well. I'm not even angry anymore.

This party needs some action! I'm going to take my clothes off. Then perhaps, yes, I'll bring the hounds in here, and the goat, and maybe that spear. And, and... set fire to the table and roast the food over it, then... where are my breeches? Oh, right, I took them off! What now, hahaha, there you are, oh, ouch!! I just sat on the spear, how... amusing. Why is everybody laughing? This is wonderful!
Pass me the wine!
[From.GetTitledFirstName] is feasting and revelling like a madman. I can hardly stand up, I am laughing so hard.
I must invite [From.GetHerHim] more often!
We are having a wonderful time. My companions say I should slow down on the drink, but that's all nonsense.
We are having a wonderful time. The beardlings say I should slow down on the ale, but a Dawi who cannot outdrink a barrel is no Dawi at all. Another!
I can handle it!
[From.GetTitledFirstName] is clearly going overboard with [From.GetHerHis] drinking.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] is drinking like a champion!
[From.GetSheHeCap] should take it easier.
Cheers!
It is good to spend time carousing in fine company. I feel wonderful, absolutely wonderful, and that means it is time to bring out the old game board.

It is good to spend time carousing in merry company. While the cups are refilled, [From.GetTitledFirstName] brings out a strange board of little carved pieces, explaining that it is a game of war. [From.GetSheHeCap] assures me it goes very well with copious amounts of drink.
We will play for money!
We will play for honour!
I suggested to [From.GetTitledFirstName] that we bring out the board and see who is the better strategist. [From.GetSheHeCap] has agreed, on the condition that we play for money.
I suggested to [From.GetTitledFirstName] that we bring out the board and see who is the better strategist. [From.GetSheHeCap] agreed, insisting that we play for honour.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] has brought out the board and pieces and suggests a few rounds to see who is the better strategist. [From.GetSheHeCap] insists that we play for money.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] has brought out the board and pieces and suggests a few rounds to see who is the better strategist. We will play for honour.
Very well, let's play!
We played for hours, the tides of fortune ebbing and flowing as I probed my opponent's lines without opening my own. At last I found the gap, made a few inspired and ruthless moves, and won the game!

We played for hours, the tides of fortune ebbing and flowing as I probed my opponent's lines without opening my own. In the end I made one fatal mistake, my opponent pounced on it, and I lost the game.
Hail to the [Root.GetTitle]!
I will get you next time.
The revelry and carousing are over... for now. Time to get back to real life.
Well, it was fun.
This is the real life!
Life is all about enjoying the company of others.
I'll dedicate all my free time to games now!

The candles have burned low and the musicians play to a hall of sleepers. In a curtained alcove [carousing_prey.GetTitledFirstName] leans close to me, flushed with my wine, laughing at nothing. I can hear [carousing_prey.GetHerHis] heart, quick and warm, and the vein that beats at [carousing_prey.GetHerHis] throat. Nobody is watching. Nobody ever is, at this hour.
A taste, no more. [carousing_prey.GetSheHeCap] will wake pale and remember a pleasant dream.
Drink deep. It has been too long.
Not here. Not tonight.

A servant was in the corridor. A guest came looking for a privy and found the alcove instead. It hardly matters who: by the end of the week the tale is in every tavern in the realm, and the details grow sharper with each telling. Pale lords who never eat. Guests who leave the feast whiter than they came.
They saw nothing. And they will say nothing, soon enough.

The dead do not eat. Even so, the tables of my hall groan with bread and dates, roast fowl and jars of beer, as the rites of the Great Land demand: the gods must see the living fed at a king's table. My guests sit among my courtiers of bone and pick at their plates in silence, and every so often one of them glances at the empty eye sockets of the servant who fills their cup.
The offerings are made and the rites are kept, as in the age of the priest-kings.
Let the living eat and drink their fill. It pleases the gods, and it pleases them.
A skeleton warrior behind every chair. Let them remember whose bread they eat.

Mortals were never meant to sit at my table. The wine tastes of honey and copper, the music has not stopped for three days, and the walls of the hall breathe when nobody is looking at them. On the third night [carousing_prey.GetTitledFirstName] begins to laugh at things no sane mind would find funny, and to answer voices only [carousing_prey.GetSheHe] can hear. [carousing_prey.GetSheHeCap] looks to me, as if I might explain.
Let the Warp keep what it has taken of [carousing_prey.GetHerHim].
[carousing_prey.GetSheHeCap] has seen enough. The soul goes to the gods.
Send [carousing_prey.GetHerHim] home whole, to tell the tale.
Such a shame...

My guests have arrived. The halls are hung with silks and thick with incense, and the tables bear dishes no sane cook would attempt: peacock tongues in honey, sugared roses, wines laced with things that make the colours sing. The musicians play music that has no right to exist. Let the feast begin, and may the Prince of Pleasure watch with envy!

My guests have arrived, and the doors are barred behind them. Cushions cover every floor, the lamps burn low and perfumed, and the wine is thick with the musk of the Dark Prince. There are no tables tonight and no rules. Let the revel begin, and let nothing be refused!

I have arrived at the house of [From.GetTitledFirstName]. The air is heavy with incense and musk, the servants wear nothing but gilded paint, and from somewhere deeper inside comes laughter, moaning and music. This is no ordinary feast.

The revel has reached its height. Bodies move in the lamplight, the incense burns sweet and heavy, and every eye turns to me, the host, to see what I will do. In the name of the Dark Prince, every pleasure is permitted tonight.
I will lead the rites of Slaanesh myself.
I will watch from the dais. It is enough to see them all fall.

The feast at [From.GetTitledFirstName]'s house has become something else entirely. Clothes are falling away, strangers are tangled on the cushions and [From.GetFirstName] is calling every guest to join the revel.
When else will I have the chance?
I slip away before anyone notices.
